English.Char_Desc_250: Viboplr is a free, open source desktop music player for Windows and macOS. It unifies local folders, Subsonic/Navidrome servers and plugin-connected services in one searchable library, with gapless mpv playback, synced lyrics, EQ and skins.
English.Char_Desc_450: Viboplr is a free, open source (GPL-3.0) desktop music player for Windows and macOS built for people who love music. It unifies local folders, Subsonic/Navidrome servers and plugin-connected streaming services in one searchable library. A native mpv engine delivers gapless, bit-perfect playback of every major format, plus a 10-band EQ, ReplayGain, crossfade, synced karaoke lyrics, endless radio, playlists, skins and a JavaScript plugin system.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
Viboplr is a free and open source (GPL-3.0) desktop music player for Windows and macOS, built for people who love music - not just stream it. It brings a whole collection together in one place: local folders, Subsonic and Navidrome servers, and streaming services connected through plugins, all searchable in a single library.
At its core is a native playback engine built on libmpv, which decodes every major audio format natively (MP3, FLAC, ALAC, OPUS, APE, WavPack, DSD, and more) with sample-accurate gapless playback, configurable crossfade, exclusive bit-perfect audio output, a 10-band equalizer, ReplayGain volume normalization, and turntable-style speed control. Video files play too, with a theater mode and storyboard seek previews. The library is backed by SQLite with accent- and case-insensitive full-text search, and folders are scanned in the background with real-time file watching.
Key features include a Home view with a radio-station carousel and shelves (recently played, most played, jump back in, liked); endless radio from any track, artist, or tag; auto-continue when the queue ends; a Now Playing view with synced karaoke lyrics, visualizers, and a waveform seek bar; playlists with M3U8 and portable .mixtape export/import; a compact always-on-top mini player; native right-click menus everywhere; 8 built-in skins plus a community gallery and custom JSON skins; and Chrome-like isolated profiles.
Viboplr is designed as an orchestrator: a JavaScript plugin system provides streaming sources, scrobbling (Last.fm built in), synced lyrics, artist and album artwork, downloads, sidebar views, home shelves, visualizers, and context-menu actions. Gallery plugins add Spotify, TIDAL, YouTube (via yt-dlp), Genius, qBittorrent, and more, with auto-updates and per-plugin settings.
Built with Tauri 2, Rust, and React for fast startup, instant playback, and a small footprint. No account required and no telemetry surprises.
